title: Page 8
content_zh:
“什么贵客？”徐夫人不知道想到了什么，脸色瞬间惨白一片，说话时嘴唇都在哆嗦。
徐庭回神，见状心生怜惜，扶着她坐下道：“大嫂要收一位姑娘做义女，先在咱们家里小住几日，然后我要出面把这姑娘送回她家里去。这事有些复杂，以后我再同你细说，你只要记得，这姑娘以后要当做侄女照顾就成。”
侄女，不是小妾？
徐夫人去了心头大石，脸色立刻好了很多，应道：“好，我这就去准备。”
“那我也同嫂子去说几句。”徐庭也起身，生怕妻子会错意，又嘱咐了一句，“这姑娘的友人救了我们全家的性命，一定不能怠慢了她。”
徐夫人吓了一跳，赶紧道：“老爷放心，我亲自带着丫鬟们拾掇。”
第十章 回京认干娘(2)
客栈里，虎妞拎了热水壶，伺候小姐洗漱，边道：“小姐，师傅说，他会带漂亮衣裙回来，让你乖乖等着，不能乱跑。”
童悠悠听了心暖又欢喜，“我明明在这里，谁说我要乱跑了？”
虎妞却不理会，笑得一口白牙都露了出来，“不乱跑就好，师傅说我完成任务就给我带好吃的。”
“你啊，到底是我的丫鬟，还是我的管家啊。”
“当然是丫鬟，但师傅也说了，小姐心软容易被欺负，要我保护好小姐。”
“别听你师傅的，世上哪有那么多坏人，不过是个例罢了，其余都是好人。”
“我师傅说得没错，小姐是个好大夫，但也是个滥好人。”
“你这么说，我倒是想起来了，你自小受寒，如今虽然瞧着壮实，但其实留了病根，过几日安定下来就要给你熬药，一日三顿喝。”
“不喝苦药，不喝苦药！”虎妞急道。
“不喝苦药不给饭吃！”童悠悠态度坚定。
师徒两个一边斗嘴，一边整理行李，其实也没多少东西，不过是几个包裹罢了。方才在城门口分开时，先前用的炭炉子之类，童悠悠都送给了吴家。
虽然吴家人算不得如何仁义，总带着几分打探的心思，但毕竟一路同行，这些东西他们以后也用得上，总比扔掉好。
没过一会儿，虎妞鼻子尖，突然嚷道：“是糖炒栗子的味道！”

她说完就奔去开门。
果然梁浩海就在门外，抬手就给了徒弟一个栗爆，恼道：“跟你说过多少遍了，不确认外边是什么人，不准开门！”
虎妞理亏，赶紧接过师傅手里的东西，讨好道：“我下次一定记得。”
童悠悠也护着她，赶紧问道：“海哥，你去过徐家了？”
“去过了，徐家一会儿就会来人接你。你先装扮起来，行李拾掇好。”说着话，他指了指买回的包裹，“里面有衣衫首饰，还有碎银铜钱，到了徐家该打赏下人就打赏，不要委屈自己。”
“好。”童悠悠见他眼下青黑，眼底红血丝凝聚，就道：“海哥，你不必陪我，还是先去忙吧。”不想耽误他的时间。
梁浩海点头，他确实没时间多耽搁，但不安顿好她，他如何放心。
“对了，那些毛皮和绣品，我先带走存起来，以后你要用了，再以徐家的名义给你送去，省得有人贪图。另外，我已经请徐大娘认你为义女，徐御史就是你的叔叔。你爹最是重名声，顾忌着这些，也会待你好三分。”
“好，我都记下了。”童悠悠一样样应下来，想起以后的日子要独自面对，突然有些茫然无措。
不想梁浩海却喊了虎妞，“拿了栗子去外边吃。”
虎妞立刻就出去了。
下一瞬，梁浩海已经把童悠悠抱在怀里。“悠悠，你别怕，有我在呢。”
童悠悠脸色爆红，理智告诉她要挣扎，但情感上却依赖这温暖的怀抱，犹豫间情感占了上风，她放任自己靠在这个熟悉又陌生的肩头。
“谢谢你为我做了这么多。”
“说什么傻话，我不护着你，你这小白兔怕是立刻就被那些豺狼虎豹吃掉了。”梁浩海轻笑，手臂却越发紧紧拥住心爱的姑娘。“在徐家也好，在童家也罢，都按照你的心意过日子，吃穿用物和银子不必担心，我会透过徐家送给你，也会常去看你。你知道，我最擅长翻窗了，是不是？”
童悠悠原本还有几分伤感，这时被他的话逗笑了。
“好，你不是羡慕虎妞的荷包吗？我……过几日就给你缝一个。”
“这个好，最好我的衣衫鞋袜你都包了。”梁浩海趁机狮子大开口，转而想起什么又后悔了，“不成，做针线太累了，我家悠悠这么漂亮清澈的大眼睛可不能累坏了。”
童悠悠脸红，终于挣开他，羞恼道：“你赶紧去忙吧，我要准备去徐家了。”
梁浩海也确实不能再耽搁了，于是，他重新握了童悠悠的手，正色道：“你

童悠悠忍着脸红，带了满心的甜蜜，重重点头，“好。”
梁浩海这才依依不舍的松开她的手，转身出了门，同虎妞轻声叮嘱几句之后，这才离开客栈。
童悠悠忍住不舍，喊了虎妞进来，换衣裙，束发戴首饰。
不知道梁浩海从哪里寻来的首饰，因为在孝中，所以不能戴金子和宝石，所以，这是全套的银首饰，样式皆是白玉兰。银簪是白玉兰的簪头，耳坠子是银底座，暖玉镶嵌成了白玉兰的花瓣。难得的是，一对玻璃种飘花的镯子里，飘花也是白玉兰的模样。衬着海蓝色的斜襟衫子，素白云绫长裙，使得童悠悠整个人添了几分娇弱，越发惹人怜惜。
虎妞说不上来什么感觉，憋了半晌才道：“小姐看着真可怜。”
童悠悠听了哭笑不得，抬手点了她的脑门，“这个时候，我们主仆两个多可怜都不为过，这是保护色。”
虎妞听不懂，但她可明白一件事，“我知道，师傅说了扮猪吃老虎，小姐这是在扮猪！”
“你才是猪，赶紧收拾东西，一会儿咱们就去寻徐大娘。”
童悠悠拾掇妆盒，撵了虎妞赶紧忙起来，省得她那张小嘴又说出什么怪话来。
果然，没有让她们等多久，不过一刻钟，抢在天色完全黑下来之前，徐夫人坐了马车赶到了。
徐夫人虽然消了疑心，但对于侵入自己家园的女子还是有几分提防，但第一眼见到童悠悠，她就彻底放了心。
这姑娘看着娇弱，眼神却极清正，甚至带了几分奇怪的悲悯，行动举止极有礼，一看就是自小被严格教养长大的。
果然，两人寒暄几句要下楼时，童悠悠戴上了帷帽，规规矩矩跟在她身后，多余一眼不看，一步不走。
徐夫人越发把心放到了肚子里，这样的姑娘是绝对不会给人做小的。就是做小，他们徐家的门第也安放不下。
马车上，徐夫人简单探问几句，童悠悠自然不能全说实话，但也没隐瞒太多。
徐夫人听了不禁叹气，好姑娘没有好运气啊！那童夫人，她也是见过的，虽然不笑不说话，极力想要人人觉得她贤慧明理，但都是一样的正房夫人，谁不知道谁的底细呢。
没想到，这么好的姑娘，居然是童家的嫡小姐，以童夫人那样娇宠亲女，这童大小姐进了童家门，如何还有活路啊！
不提她的担忧，一路到了徐家，徐大娘带了徐庭，还有小孙女莲姐儿，外加十几个奴仆都等在门口。
content_en:
"What kind of distinguished guest?" Mrs. Xu didn't know what she thought of. Her face instantly turned pale, and her lips were trembling as she spoke.
Xu Ting came back to his senses and felt pity when he saw this. He helped her sit down and said, "My sister-in-law is going to adopt a girl as a foster daughter. She will stay in our house for a few days, and then I will step in and send the girl back to her home. This matter is a bit complicated. I will explain it to you in detail later. Just remember that this girl will be taken care of as a niece in the future."
Niece, not concubine?
Mrs. Xu was relieved, her complexion immediately improved a lot, and she said, "Okay, I'll go get ready right now."
"Then I will also go and have a few words with my sister-in-law." Xu Ting also stood up, fearing that his wife would get the wrong idea, and gave another instruction, "This girl's friend saved our family's lives, so we must not neglect her."
Mrs. Xu was startled and said quickly: "Don't worry, sir, I will personally take the maids to clean it up."
Chapter 10 Returning to Beijing to Acknowledge My Godmother (2)
In the inn, Huniu brought a hot water bottle and helped the young lady wash up. She said, "Miss, the master said that he will bring back beautiful clothes and ask you to wait obediently and not to run around."
Tong Youyou felt warm and happy after hearing this, "I'm obviously here, who said I'm going to run away?"
Huniu ignored her and smiled so much that her white teeth were exposed, "Just don't run around. Master will bring me delicious food when I complete the task."
"Are you my maid or my butler?"
"Of course she is a maid, but the master also said that the young lady is soft-hearted and easily bullied, and asked me to protect the young lady."
"Don't listen to your master. There are so many bad people in the world. They are just an exception. The rest are good people."
"My master is right. The young lady is a good doctor, but she is also a bad person."
"You said that, and I remembered that you have suffered from cold since you were a child. Although you look strong now, you actually have the root of the disease. In a few days, when you have settled down, I will make some medicine for you and drink it three times a day."
"Don't drink bitter medicine, don't drink bitter medicine!" Huniu said anxiously.
"If you don't drink the bitter medicine, you won't be given food!" Tong Youyou said firmly.
The master and apprentice were bickering while packing their luggage. In fact, there wasn't much, just a few packages. When they separated at the city gate just now, Tong Youyou gave all the charcoal stoves and other things used before to the Wu family.
Although the Wu family is not very benevolent and always has a bit of inquiring mind, after all, they are traveling all the way, and they will use these things in the future, which is better than throwing them away.
After a while, Huniu pointed her nose and suddenly shouted: "It smells like sugar-roasted chestnuts!"
After she finished speaking, she ran to open the door.
Sure enough, Liang Haohai was right outside the door. He raised his hand and gave his apprentice a slap in the face, saying angrily: "How many times have I told you that you are not allowed to open the door without confirming who is outside!"
Huniu understood the mistake and quickly took the things from the master's hand and said flatteringly: "I will definitely remember it next time."
Tong Youyou also protected her and asked quickly: "Brother Hai, have you been to Xu's house?"
"I've been there. Someone from the Xu family will come to pick you up soon. You dress up first and pack your luggage." As he spoke, he pointed to the package he bought. "There are clothes, jewelry, and broken silver and copper coins in it. When you get to the Xu family, you can reward your servants when it's time. Don't wrong yourself."
"Okay." Tong Youyou saw that his eyes were green and black, and the red bloodshot eyes were condensed, so she said: "Brother Hai, you don't have to accompany me, you should go and do your work first." She didn't want to waste his time.
Liang Haohai nodded. He really didn't have time to delay, but if he couldn't settle her down, how could he rest assured.
"By the way, I will take away those furs and embroidery and store them. If you want to use them later, I will send them to you in the name of the Xu family to prevent anyone from trying to covet them. In addition, I have asked Aunt Xu to recognize you as my adopted daughter, and Xu Yushi will be your uncle. Your father values ​​his reputation the most. If he cares about these, he will treat you well."
"Okay, I've written it all down." Tong Youyou responded to everything. Thinking of having to face the future alone, she suddenly felt a little at a loss.Liang Haohai didn't want to but called Huniu, "Take the chestnuts and go outside to eat."
Hu Niu went out immediately.
The next moment, Liang Haohai had Tong Youyou in his arms. "Yuyou, don't be afraid, I'm here."
Tong Youyou's face turned red, her reason told her to struggle, but she relied on this warm embrace emotionally. She hesitated and her emotions took over, and she let herself lean on this familiar yet unfamiliar shoulder.
"Thank you for doing so much for me."
"What nonsense are you talking about? If I don't protect you, you little white rabbit will be eaten by those jackals, tigers and leopards immediately." Liang Haohai chuckled, but his arms hugged his beloved girl more tightly. "Whether you are in the Xu family or the Tong family, I will live according to your wishes. Don't worry about food, clothing and money. I will give them to you through the Xu family and visit you often. You know that I am the best at climbing through windows, right?"
Tong Youyou was still a little sad at first, but now she was amused by his words.
"Okay, don't you envy Hu Niu's purse? I... will sew one for you in a few days."
"Okay, it's best if you cover all my clothes, shoes and socks." Liang Haohai took the opportunity to speak loudly, then thought of something and regretted it, "No, I'm too tired from doing needlework. My Yuyou's beautiful and clear big eyes can't be exhausted."
Tong Youyou blushed, finally broke away from him, and said angrily: "Go and get busy, I'm going to Xu's house."
Liang Haohai really couldn't delay any longer, so he shook Tong Youyou's hand again and said seriously: "You
Tong Youyou held back her blush, and nodded with a heart full of sweetness, "Okay. "
Liang Haohai reluctantly let go of her hand, turned around and walked out the door. After whispering a few words to Huniu, he left the inn.
Tong Youyou couldn't help but called Huniu to come in, change her clothes, tie her hair and put on jewelry.
I don’t know where Liang Haohai found the jewelry. Because he was in Xiaozhong, he couldn’t wear gold and gemstones, so this is a complete set of silver jewelry, all in the style of white magnolia. The silver hairpin is made of white magnolia, the earrings are made of silver base, and the warm jade is inlaid with the petals of white magnolia. What is rare is that in a pair of glass bracelets with floating flowers, the floating flowers also look like white magnolias. Wearing a sea blue slanted shirt and a plain white cloud damask skirt, Tong Youyou's whole body looks a little more delicate and more pitiable.
Huniu couldn't tell what she was feeling, so she held it in for a while before saying, "Young lady looks so pitiful. "
Tong Youyou didn't know whether to laugh or cry when she heard this. She raised her hand and tapped her forehead, "At this time, it's hard to overstate how pitiful we master and servant are. This is a protective look. "
Hu Niu didn’t understand, but she understood one thing, “I know, the master said that you should pretend to be a pig and eat the tiger, but Miss is pretending to be a pig! "
"You are the pig, pack your things quickly, we will go find Aunt Xu in a moment. "
Tong Youyou packed up her makeup box and asked Huniu to get busy, so as not to say anything weird again with her little mouth.
Sure enough, they were not kept waiting long, but within a quarter of an hour, before it got completely dark, Mrs. Xu arrived in a carriage.
Although Mrs. Xu had dispelled her suspicions, she was still a little wary of women invading her home. But when she first saw Tong Youyou, she was completely relieved.
This girl looks delicate, but her eyes are very pure, even with a bit of strange compassion, and her actions are very polite. It can be seen that she has been raised strictly since she was a child.
Sure enough, when the two of them exchanged a few words and were about to go downstairs, Tong Youyou put on her curtain hat and followed her politely, without even looking at her or taking a step away.
Mrs. Xu put her heart more and more into her stomach, such a girl would never be teased by others. Even if they are small, their Xu family's family status will not be able to accommodate them.
On the carriage, Mrs. Xu asked a few questions. Of course, Tong Youyou couldn't tell the whole truth, but she didn't hide too much.
Mrs. Xu couldn't help but sigh after hearing this, good girls don't have good luck! She has also seen Mrs. Tong, although she doesn't smile or speak., trying her best to make everyone think she is virtuous and sensible, but they are all the same as the principal wife, and no one knows who the other’s background is.
Unexpectedly, such a good girl is actually the direct daughter of the Tong family. With Mrs. Tong doting on her own daughter, how can this young lady still survive after entering the Tong family?
Regardless of her worries, when they arrived at Xu's house, Aunt Xu brought Xu Ting, her granddaughter Sister Lian, and a dozen servants waiting at the door.
